notes.title: Persona 5 Strikers Version 1.02
notes.content:
Hello Persona 5 Strikers players! This release is Persona 5 Strikers, version 1.2. 

Thank you for reporting issues and participating in our Beta releases! Your feedback and involvement are crucial. We have rolled our beta patch over to the Main Branch. This release contains previous gameplay and stability issues addressed with Hot Fix 1 and Hot Fix 2. Here is a comprehensive list of fixes made: 

[list] 

[*]Increased stability of the game against crashes and hang issues. 

[*]Addressed an issue in which some users are getting an error message that the game cannot be run on their current OS, even though they are using Windows 10.[/list]

notes.title: Please try the open beta branch for Persona 5 Strikers!
notes.content:
Hello Phantom Thieves! 

Thank you for reporting your issues with Persona 5 Strikers. 

Our team has addressed a number of issues reported and have rolled them to the beta branch. A full list of the issues addressed are listed at the bottom of this message. 

This is an opt-in hotfix, so if you would like to opt in, please do the following: 

From Persona 5 Strikers in your Steam library, right click and go to Properties. Navigate to the BETAS tab and enter the beta access code: 

H5328QXV3R74myei3uhh6ab2Pa5pUitjmVh 

From the drop down menu, select “hotfix1”. 

Issues addressed in this hotfix: 

[list]
[*] Increased stability of the game against crashes and hang issues.  
[*] Addressed an issue in which some users are getting an error message that the game cannot be run on their current OS, even though they are using Windows 10. 
[/list]

If you are not experiencing any major issues, we recommend not opting into the beta branch. 

UPDATE: 4/12/2021

Thank you for reporting issues and participating in our Beta release! Your feedback and involvement are crucial as we continue to improve the Steam release. 
 
We have prepared Hotfix 2, which should further increase stability of the game against crashes and hang issues. 
 
Here’s how to access it: 
 
Branch Name: hotfix2 
Branch Password: jE29Ct7V3gGf3CWpYwrKeSEY9KVRUUZKr

If you are not experiencing further issues with hotfix 1 we recommend not opting into the latest branch.

Please post issues in this thread regarding this beta so that we can further identify technical issues. We appreciate your feedback and information you provided us. 

Thank you! 

ATLUS Comms
